licence: SRTM is a public-domain NASA/NGA dataset distributed by USGS; USGS requests credit when redistributed or published (tilezen/joerd docs/attribution.md).
limitations: SRTM was acquired in February 2000: it predates later construction and land-use change.
It is a surface model (canopy and buildings included), not a bare-earth terrain model, with a vertical error of several metres; small drainage features are not resolved at 30 m.
Voids are flagged -32768 and are left as NODATA, never filled.
Elevations refer to the EGM96 geoid.
Slope is a 30 m neighbourhood estimate from SRTM; it smooths small embankments and cuttings and includes SRTM vertical noise.
Cells within one cell of nodata or of the raster edge have no slope (left as nodata, not extrapolated).
source_name: SRTM 1 arc-second (SRTMGL1) via Mapzen/Tilezen terrain tiles, 'skadi' layout
